note: Non-till translation surfaces (ADR-0177 §1). Each surface is one Weblate component of the same slug; its English and key metadata live in the code repo and tools/sync_english.py --surface <name> copies them to <component>/en.json and meta/<component>.json. `namespaces` (optional) keeps only keys whose first dotted segment is listed, so one repo can feed several components; `catch_all: true` takes every key no sibling surface (same repo and English file) claims. ut-cloud's real namespaces are manage_app, admin_app, partner_app (its ?ns= values); the cloud entries are provisional until ADR-0177 slice 6 adds ut-cloud/i18n/en.json. Hand-kept because it names repos, not languages; the till areas stay in the generated meta/areas.json.
